mapper.sql: id , tenant_id, kb_id , query , strategy , retrieve_count , qa_hit , avg_similarity , max_similarity , cost_time , feedback_score , feedback_remark , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt

if.test: deleteFlag != null and id == null and ids == null

mapper.insert: insert into kb_retrieve_log (tenant_id, kb_id , query , strategy , retrieve_count , qa_hit , avg_similarity , max_similarity , cost_time , feedback_score , feedback_remark , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt) values (#{tenantId}, #{kbId} , #{query} , #{strategy} , #{retrieveCount} , #{qaHit} , #{avgSimilarity} , #{maxSimilarity} , #{costTime} , #{feedbackScore} , #{feedbackRemark} , 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.update: update kb_retrieve_log set delete_flag = -1 , updated_by = #{updatedBy} , updated_dt = #{updatedDt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalRetrieveCount, COALESCE(avg(avg_similarity), 0) as avgSimilarity, COALESCE(sum(case when qa_hit = 1 then 1 else 0 end) * 100 / count(*), 0) as qaHitRate, COALESCE(sum(case when retrieve_count = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as noResultCount, COALESCE(avg(case when feedback_score is not null then feedback_score end), 0) as avgFeedbackScore, COALESCE(sum(case when feedback_score is not null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as feedbackCount, COALESCE(avg(cost_time), 0) as avgCostTime from kb_retrieve_log where 1 = 1

select count(case when created_dt >= #{todayStart} then 1 end) as todayCount, count(case when created_dt >= #{weekStart} then 1 end) as weekCount, count(case when created_dt >= #{monthStart} then 1 end) as monthCount from kb_retrieve_log where delete_flag = 1 and created_dt >= #{monthStart}
and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
